title: Kazatomprom
summary: Kazakh state-controlled uranium producer, the largest in the world.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Kazatomprom produces uranium through in-situ leaching in Kazakhstan and sells to utilities and traders worldwide. It is the largest low-cost uranium producer, and its output decisions influence global prices. Ownership, tax and logistics links to Russia are persistent risks.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium mining and concentrate
  • Uranium sales to utilities
  • Rare-metal by-products

What To Watch

  • Production guidance
  • Uranium prices
  • Export routes and sanctions

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
